spec.example.toml · point

cell11examplepi convention
arp23.junction_angle_form

g1-junction-1013 (PI 2026-10-13 22:32, DECISIONS-1013-2232 item 5: arp23.branch_angle_max = 84 deg is provisional; replace the junction's angle representation by one regular at 90 deg): DECLARED ARM, selector of the REPRESENTATION of one law (the junction holds its branch angle at stiffness arp23.k_theta). 0 (default until the device comparison) = the two second-difference triple rows (m, d0, d1) and (m_b, m, d1), stiffness arp23.k_theta / lever^2: the row at the daughter's first node is collinear at a 90 deg daughter, so the draw is bounded by arp23.branch_angle_max. 1 = ONE two-direction angle element per junction (physics.energy.rowangle; assemble.junction_angle_table): E = k_theta (theta - theta0)^2 / 2, theta the angle between the daughter's first chord d1 - d0 and the mother's chord m_b - m, theta0 the junction's DRAWN angle; exact Hessian projected PSD; regular for every theta0 in (0, 180) deg, so arp23.branch_angle_max IS NOT READ (the draw is the declared 70 +/- 7 law on (0, 180)); the two triple rows stay as carriers (their nodes and life move and switch the element: relation_life at a debranch, chain_birth at a wake) with kappa 0. Needs arp23.junction_rule = 1 (refused otherwise). Of the junction's four angular degrees of freedom (the direction of the 8 nm gap d0 - m and of the daughter's chord, at fixed lengths) level 0 holds two and level 1 ONE (host rank of the junction block on P05 / C03 / U1: 2 vs 1): level 1 leaves the gap's direction free (reach: the gap length) beside the azimuth about the mother, level 0 left the azimuth and the turn about the m - d1 line. Host spectra (lane hand-back): largest junction-block eigenvalue median / max 1.1e4 / 1.1e5 pN/um at level 0 (bound 84 deg), 50 / 70-82 pN/um at level 1. Not a measurement: a switch

arp23.azimuth_rule

f7-arp23-1013 (PI 2026-10-13 18:16 'the junction is rigid, including azimuth'; Lead decision on the reference: the other attachment points on the same mother): DECLARED ARM. 1 (default) = each pair of junctions adjacent along one mother holds its azimuth difference, E = k [1 - cos(phi - phi0)], k = material.<mother>.torsional_rigidity / contour between them, phi0 = the dihedral as built (the builder's azimuth draw; no helix-twist row exists to derive it from) — assemble.junction_dihedral_table, physics.energy.dihedral. 0 = no azimuth law: every daughter swivels freely about its mother's axis, bit for bit the l6-arp23-1013 build. Level 1 leaves free: a mother with one occupied node; junctions on one node relative to each other; a daughter born at run time (physics.chain_birth writes no element). No material frame (the general representation) — see the lane hand-back

spec.example.toml · range

cell1.31/(uM.s)0.59–2.86sweptmeasured
filamin.k_off0

Ferrer 2008 PNAS measured filamin unbinding beside alpha-actinin (0.087 +/- 0.073 /s, the single-bond Hummer-Szabo intrinsic rate; the paper is SE119, audit OK, but SE119's claim text anchors only alpha-actinin's 0.066 /s, so this value is VERIFY). 0.087 is the prior EXAMPLE, untouched by #117 (PI-delegated 2026-09-25 02:51: notes only). The kind's catch-slip rows are TWO fits combined: this slip row (with filamin.x_beta 0.4 nm, which has no line in Ferrer - see that row) and the catch branch of the Pereverzev card KU-3.19 (filamin.k_catch0 0.1 /s, filamin.x_catch 0.8 nm), whose own slip pair is 0.02 /s, 0.3 nm. The zero-load total dissociation is the slip rate + the catch rate; for the pair in this file (Ferrer slip + card catch) 0.087 + 0.1 = 0.187 /s, 3.2x slower than the measured bulk k-1 ~ 0.6 /s (Goldmann & Isenberg 1993 FEBS Lett 336:408, SE569 audit OK, abstract verbatim) - the same single-bond-below-bulk convention as the crosslink's signed pairing. Whether the catch branch has an interior lifetime peak (k_catch0 x_catch > k_off0 x_beta) is a property of which pair is combined, not evidence for any value of this row. The value waits for the PI's ONE decision, stated as whole fits (310 K; f* = kT ln(k_c x_c / k_s x_s)/(x_c + x_s); gain = the zero-load total over the rate at f*): (a) the card's four rows - total 0.12 /s, bulk shortfall 5.0x, f* 10.1 pN, gain 2.15x; (b) this hybrid as filed - 0.187 /s, 3.2x, f* 3.0 pN, gain 1.09x (with Ferrer's own filamin x‡ 0.194 nm: f* 6.7 pN, gain 1.28x); (c) a bulk-anchored total ~0.6 /s (SE569), 1x - needs a catch-slip fit that closes on it, which no row here has. not in KB source_audit as a filamin value — register before SOURCED

SOURCED PI 2026-09-24 18:38 (Lead transcript c6b6353e): crossover ~365 A, observed range 347-385 A (McGough, Pope, Chiu & Weeds 1997 J Cell Biol 138:771, 10.1083/jcb.138.4.771, PMID 9265645, SE572 source_audit OK); Galkin 2015 Structure (166.7 deg / 27.6 A -> 373.5 A) and von der Ecken 2015 Nature (166.4 deg / 27.5 A -> 364.0 A) agree. One linker per site (PI 2026-09-24 11:38). Read by BondKind.material_site_period; the same row gives C1's per-pair multiplicity. | independent of crosslink.site_period: different linkers; same actin half-pitch value. 10.1083/jcb.138.4.771

which epitope lattice this linker's sites belong to (backlog #98): kinds with the same positive number share one lattice and exclude each other within the sum of their site_exclusion half-widths along the filament; 0 = its own lattice. osmotic.law_arm

ARM SELECTOR, not a measurement (PARALLEL-TRACKS; none is the answer): 0 = ideal van 't Hoff (every species one osmole; the shipped law), 1 = constant osmotic coefficient per species group (osmotic.coefficient_*), 2 = second virial on the macro-anion and colloid (osmotic.virial_*), 3 = 1 and 2 together (PI 22:14 Q5), 4 = Debye-Hueckel (contact distance osmotic.ion_size) and 5 = its limiting law, 6 = Pitzer (osmotic.pitzer_*): 4-6 are COMPOSITION-DEPENDENT, evaluated on device from each pool's live species counts at every energy evaluation (PI 22:14 '그것자체가 고정값이 되는 것은 싫은데'). Same world, same species counts, same record; only the derived cytosol osmolyte/colloid and the nucleoplasm colloid re-close the rest balances under the arm. Read only with solute.ion_transport = 1 (refused otherwise). | PI 2026-10-07 21:43 (transcript ef9e7f17) '삼투압은 고정된 값들이 아님! 그리고 여러 모델링들을 하나 선택하는 상황보다 여러개 두고 일단은 나중에 판단하는 것이 좋아보임'

spec.example.toml · range

cell010–6example
osmotic.coefficient_ion

arm 1: practical osmotic coefficient of the small ions (Na, K, Cl, Ca, bath counter-anion), one row for all. 0.93 = NaCl near 0.15 mol/kg (Robinson & Stokes, Electrolyte Solutions, 2nd ed. 1959, appendix tables; textbook, not consulted in this lane); band 0.85 (CaCl2/KCl-rich mixtures, lower) to 1.0 (ideal). Not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED. Constant phi (no concentration dependence) is itself a declared simplification of this arm.

spec.example.toml · range

cell0.9310.85–1.0sweptsecondary
osmotic.coefficient_osmolyte

arm 1: osmotic coefficient of the derived neutral small osmolyte (amino acids, sugars, metabolites, lumped). Not sourced: a +/-5 % bracket around ideal stated without a source; not in KB source_audit.

spec.example.toml · range

cell1.010.95–1.05sweptsecondary
osmotic.coefficient_macroanion

arm 1: osmotic coefficient of the lumped impermeant macro-anion (cytosol.macroanion_valence). Not sourced: a lumped species of proteins, nucleic acids and phosphates has no single measured phi; bracket stated without a source. Joint corners of the prior (e.g. 1.2 with coefficient_ion 0.85) can make the derived cytosol osmolyte negative: composition() then REFUSES that draw, it does not adjust.

spec.example.toml · range

cell1.010.7–1.2sweptsecondary
osmotic.coefficient_colloid

arm 1: osmotic coefficient of the pore-excluded nuclear colloid (nucleus.impermeant_conc). Not sourced: macromolecular solutions run above ideal when crowded (excluded volume) and below with attraction; bracket stated without a source. Note nucleus.impermeant_conc is itself quoted as an ideal-van 't Hoff osmolarity from a measured pressure, so phi != 1 here changes the pressure that row stood for (PI question).

spec.example.toml · range

cell1.010.5–2.0sweptsecondary
osmotic.virial_macroanion

arm 2: second osmotic virial coefficient of the lumped macro-anion, Pi/kT = c + B c^2. Not measured: hard-sphere B2 = 4 v N_A (excluded volume of a sphere pair) for an effective radius 0.3-0.6 nm (metabolite phosphates to small peptides); value at 0.4 nm. 1/mM = 1000 L/mol. Attraction (B < 0) is not carried. Not in KB source_audit.

spec.example.toml · range

cell0.000651/mM0.00027–0.0022sweptsecondary
osmotic.virial_colloid

arm 2: second osmotic virial coefficient of the nuclear colloid. Not measured for nucleoplasm: hard-sphere B2 = 4 v N_A for a globular protein of radius 1.5-4 nm; value at 2.5 nm (4 x 4/3 pi (2.5 nm)^3 x 6.022e23 = 158 L/mol). Real proteins add charge repulsion (B larger at low salt) or attraction (smaller); neither is carried. Not in KB source_audit.

osmotic.ion_size

arm 4: Debye-Hueckel contact distance a of the pool's ions (one mean value for the mixture). Kielland 1937 JACS 59:1675 ion-size parameters: K+, Cl- ~0.3 nm, Na+ ~0.45 nm, Ca2+ ~0.6 nm, up to ~0.9 nm for small hydrated divalents; value 0.4 nm a mixture mean stated without a fit. Textbook values as recalled, not consulted in this lane; not in KB source_audit. PI 2026-10-07 22:14 (via Lead, transcript ef9e7f17)

osmotic.pitzer_e_theta

ARM SELECTOR (PARALLEL-TRACKS; Lead 2026-10-07 22:5x relaying, transcript ef9e7f17): Pitzer arm 6's unsymmetric mixing E-theta(I) for like-sign pairs of unequal charge (Pitzer 1975 J Solution Chem 4:249; computed from A_phi by the J-function quadrature, no value row). 1 = on (default), 0 = off (theta alone).

spec.example.toml · range

cell110–1example
osmotic.external_reading

ARM SELECTOR (PI 22:14 Q2/Q4): how osmotic.external and osmotic.external_at_start are read when the bath's neutral osmolyte is derived. 0 = an ideal count total (sum c, the shipped reading); 1 = a MEASURED osmolality (osmometer reading), i.e. the bath's osmotic pressure / kT under the osmotic-law arm in force (phi-, virial- and excess-weighted). Identical under law_arm 0. PI 2026-10-07 22:14 (via Lead, transcript ef9e7f17)

spec.example.toml · range

cell010–1example
osmotic.water_permeation

SWITCH, not a measurement — SHIPPED ON since PI 2026-10-07 21:03 (Q5, transcript ef9e7f17; aleph/docs/PENDING_DEFAULT_FLIPS.toml osmosis-water-permeation = flipped, device verification U1/U4 still to run). 0 = the K_V/V0 comparison arm (membrane/envelope.volume_modulus act). 1 binds cell/transport_build -> physics/surface_transport (face law q = n.(Vv - Ju), R = A/Lp, Pi = kBT(Nin/Vin - Nout/Vout) from the enclosed geometry). 0 = the shipped build, unchanged. With 1, membrane.pressure must be 0.0 (the declared turgor becomes the comparison target, not a second load) and StepConfig.fluid_volume_consistent must be false (this law replaces that numerical correction). | range added at integration 2026-10-07 22:00 (Lead; tag-ratchet); arm selector, both arms run

cell110–1example
osmotic.external_water_volume

finite closed outside bath, 1e6 um^3 = 1 nL, ~1e5 x a cell: large enough that the outside concentration barely moves, finite so the two solute pools and the total water volume are conserved exactly. A real chamber volume replaces it. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

spec.example.toml · point

cell1000000.0um^3example
osmotic.reference_temperature

the declared reference of the unit conversion, not a biological parameter: osmotic.pressure_per_mM is R x this temperature (8.314 x 310 = 2577 Pa/mM), checked at build. Runtime pressure uses the actual kBT and molecule counts, so changing cell.temperature does not freeze RT here. | independent of cell.temperature: the unit-conversion reference vs the cell's temperature; same value 310 K by definition of the reference, checked at build, not bound.

spec.example.toml · point

cell310.0Ksourcedpi convention
osmotic.external_at_start

the bath's osmolarity at t = 0 (its neutral osmolyte column, cell/solute_build.composition); bound to osmotic.external, the medium the cell is balanced in. An osmotic-shock world (U1) sets a value apart: the cell is built balanced and transferred at t = 0.

spec.example.toml · alias

cell= osmotic.externalmMexample
solute.nucleoplasm_start_arm

ARM SELECTOR (PI 22:14 Q4 opened): the nucleoplasm's starting ions. 0 = the cytosol's ion concentrations, the macro-anion closing electroneutrality (shipped); 1 = DONNAN equilibrium across the envelope: the pore-excluded macro-anion at the cytosol's concentration and the mobile ions (Na, K, Cl, Ca) at c_cyt r^z with r solving the nucleoplasm's electroneutrality against its node fixed charge. Identical to 0 when solute.macroanion_charge_source = 0 (no nucleoplasm fixed charge). 2 = Donnan AND its potential laid at t = 0 (Lead 22:4x Q4): q = C_env A_env (-kT ln r) e of K moved cytosol -> nucleoplasm, so the envelope capacitor starts at the Donnan potential and the membrane's at 0; 1 leaves both pools neutral (potential 0). PI 2026-10-07 22:14 (via Lead, transcript ef9e7f17)

spec.example.toml · range

cell52.0pN.s/um^226.0–104.0sweptmeasured
nucleus.impermeant_conc

the nucleoplasm's IMPERMEANT solute, as its ideal-van 't Hoff osmolarity: the colloid the nuclear pores hold back, which sets envelope.volume_modulus = this x osmotic.pressure_per_mM (derive.van_t_hoff_modulus; R-D3, PI 2026-10-06). Evidence and quotes: aleph/docs/v2_audit/NOTE-2026-10-06-nucleus-volume-modulus.md. Value 0.582 mM = 1.5 kPa / 2577, the MIDDLE of the favoured nuclear colloid osmotic pressure 'around 1-2 kPa' (Mitchison 2019 MBoC 10.1091/mbc.E18-09-0549, frog oocyte nucleus as osmometer; a stated choice inside that band). Band 0.097-3.10 mM = 250 Pa (nuclear bulk modulus 0.25 nN/um^2 from Dahl 2004 osmotic swelling of isolated Xenopus oocyte nuclei, via Li 2015 BPJ Table 1; Dahl = SE562 audit OK, Li not audited) to 8 kPa (nucleoplasmic localized-protein pressure, an upper limit, Deviri & Safran 2022 PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2118301119). Isolated nuclei shrink under macromolecules, not ions (Finan 2009 ABME 10.1007/s10439-008-9618-5). Mitchison 2019, Deviri 2022 and Finan 2009 are NOT in the KB source_audit: register before SOURCED. Transfer: frog / Xenopus / porcine chondrocyte, no MCF7 value. Ideal solution; the Donnan (fixed-charge) term is assessed in the NOTE and left out (<= 600 Pa upper bound, not measurable in Finan's ion test). Was 2.0 mM EXAMPLE (order-of-magnitude guess) in e1b5e5399 10.1091/mbc.E18-09-0549

kinesin.site_period

the kinesin's binding lattice along the microtubule — its PRESENCE puts the motor on the engine's SITE path (physics/site_attach: bind at a site, one site per walk event; BACKLOG #56, DESIGN-2026-09-25-walking-kinds-on-sites), DEFAULT since PI 2026-10-13 18:16 KST (DECISIONS-1013-1816 item 15: the step is the 8 nm site path, not the node spacing). BOUND to kinesin.step, itself bound to microtubule.dimer_rise (one tubulin dimer, 0.008 um): one event = one stride = one hydrolysis cycle, rate = kinesin.velocity / step, independent of resolution.spacing; bonds._motor refuses a period that is not the stride. The node walk (one event = microtubule.seg, seg/step cycles) stays reachable as the declared comparison arm motor.node_walk = 1

barrier splitting theta in [0, 1] of the energy-based transition law (physics.transition_energy; PI-BATCH-2016 A2): where along the reaction coordinate the barrier sits. NOT MEASURED for this molecule — SWEPT on its range; 0.5 is the symmetric midpoint, not a fit. theta_bind: the attach weight's share exp(-theta_bind 1/2 k e^2/kT) of the strain energy; the release that mirrors the attach reads 1 - theta_bind (Dembo 1988 harmonic-bond pair: detailed balance at every load). 0 is refused (a weightless attach has no energy to share).

NOT MEASURED for this molecule — SWEPT on its range; 0.5 is the symmetric midpoint, not a fit. theta_release: a release no attach mirrors (ADP / ATP-induced detachment), rate k0 exp(theta_release 1/2 k e^2/kT).

NOT MEASURED for this molecule — SWEPT on its range; 0.5 is the symmetric midpoint, not a fit. theta_stroke: the forward stroke / walk (rest shift, node walk, lever pre->post switch energy), rate k0 exp(-theta_stroke dE/kT); its mirror reads 1 - theta_stroke.

kinesin.reverse_walk

No effect on the legacy arm.

dynein.site_period

the dynein's binding lattice along the microtubule — its PRESENCE puts the motor on the engine's SITE path (physics/site_attach: bind at a site, one site per walk event; BACKLOG #56, DESIGN-2026-09-25-walking-kinds-on-sites), DEFAULT since PI 2026-10-13 18:16 KST (DECISIONS-1013-1816 item 15: the step is the 8 nm site path, not the node spacing). BOUND to dynein.step, itself bound to microtubule.dimer_rise (one tubulin dimer, 0.008 um): one event = one stride = one hydrolysis cycle, rate = dynein.velocity / step, independent of resolution.spacing; bonds._motor refuses a period that is not the stride. The node walk (one event = microtubule.seg, seg/step cycles) stays reachable as the declared comparison arm motor.node_walk = 1

binding predicate (l2rules-1015, Cytosim couple specificity, C8): a free dynein binds only where the cosine of its owner strand's plus-end tangent with the partner strand's lies in [pair_cos_lo, pair_cos_hi]; parallel [c0, 1], antiparallel [-1, -c0], orthogonal [-e, e]. -1 / 1 = any orientation (the incumbent). An owner on no strand (a cargo) is not filtered

dynein.diffusion_1d

substrate.thickness

gel thickness ~50 um; thin-gel corrections below ~10 um. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

spec.example.toml · range

cell50.0um5.0–500.0swept
motor.node_walk

switch, DECLARED ARM (PI 2026-10-13 18:16 KST, DECISIONS-1013-1816 item 15; lane l9-motors-cargo-1013): 0 = kinesin and dynein bind and walk at SITES of <m>.site_period (8 nm, one hydrolysis cycle per event) — the default. 1 = the pre-1013 NODE walk kept as a comparison arm: one event moves the relation one microtubule node (microtubule.seg = resolution.spacing, 6.25 cycles per event at 0.05 um; up to kinesin.k x seg = 15 pN per event, above the stall force), built field for field as before the site rows existed (bonds._motor ignores <m>.site_period / site_group / site_exclusion)

spec.example.toml · range

cell010–1example
motor.end_rule

switch, DECLARED ARM (l2rules-1015, Cytosim H4 hold_growing_end / hold_shrinking_end; spec_L1_L2_L3_L9 L2-a): 0 = a kinesin / dynein walk that reaches a chain end SATURATES there (stays bound, counted n_walk_saturated) whatever the end's state — the incumbent; 1 = the end rule of <m>.hold_growing_end / <m>.hold_shrinking_end (physics.kinetics.rule_tables end_hold: 1 stay, 0 release into the free state; the shrinking flag also makes a site row FOLLOW a depolymerising end instead of releasing). Turning it on is a default change for the PI (PENDING_DEFAULT_FLIPS)

spec.example.toml · range

cell010–1example
motor.consistency_tolerance

the RATIO band inside which velocity/k_off0 must agree with run_length (cell/bonds.check_motor_consistency). 2x is the scatter single-molecule motor numbers carry across assays and labs (buffer, ATP, load geometry, surface); a tighter band would refuse published rows, a looser one would accept a molecule that is not one. Declared as a band, not fitted: the shipped kinesin rows land at 1.25x and dynein at 1.00x

cell2.01example
transport.kinesin_cargo_fraction

EXAMPLE partition of the finite kinesin complex pool into KIF5-like cargo dimers and kinesin-5 sliding tetramers; cell state/species abundance inference input. Copied verbatim from codex/bio-wiring-20260915 transport_inputs.fragment.toml

spec.example.toml · range

cell0.810.08–1.0swept
transport.dynein_cargo_fraction

EXAMPLE partition of the finite dynein complex pool into DDB-like cargo transport and cortical pulling species. Copied verbatim from codex/bio-wiring-20260915 transport_inputs.fragment.toml

spec.example.toml · range

cell0.610.06–1.0swept
transport.kinesin_free_fraction

switch, DECLARED ARM (L3, Cytosim.md C9/S3): 0 = every kinesin is a relation owned by a microtubule node or a cargo carrier (the incumbent); above 0 = round(kinesin.count x this) kinesin are free massive nodes (free_kinesin) that diffuse and bind by the kind's own k_on. Taken out of the sliding rest, so transport.kinesin_cargo_fraction + this <= 1

spec.example.toml · range

cell010.0–1.0swept
transport.kinesin_bipolar_fraction

switch, DECLARED ARM (U10): 0 = no two-arm molecule; above 0 = round(kinesin.count x this) massive bipolar molecules, each centre node owning two distinct-microtubule relations. Must not exceed transport.kinesin_free_fraction; no point is selected

spec.example.toml · range

cell010.0–1.0swept
transport.dynein_free_fraction

switch, DECLARED ARM (L3, Cytosim.md C9/S3): 0 = every dynein is a relation owned by a cortex anchor or a cargo carrier (the incumbent); above 0 = round(dynein.count x this) dynein are free massive nodes (free_dynein). Taken out of the cortical rest, so transport.dynein_cargo_fraction + this <= 1

spec.example.toml · range

cell010.0–1.0swept
transport.dynein_bipolar_fraction

switch, DECLARED ARM (U10): 0 = no two-arm molecule; above 0 = round(dynein.count x this) massive bipolar molecules, each centre node owning two distinct-microtubule relations. Must not exceed transport.dynein_free_fraction; no point is selected

cargo.radius

EXAMPLE 120 nm diameter liposome carrier from Jiang et al 2025, DOI 10.1016/j.bpj.2025.04.033; assay transfer, not measured native cell vesicle distribution. Copied verbatim from codex/bio-wiring-20260915 transport_inputs.fragment.toml 10.1016/j.bpj.2025.04.033

spec.example.toml · range

cell0.06um0.006–0.6swept
cargo.kinesin_per_cargo

kinesin motors ONE cargo carrier holds (PI 2026-10-13 18:16 KST, DECISIONS-1013-1816 item 16: a cargo carries several motors; bonds.cargo_team / cargo_ranges). The kinesin cargo motors stay kinesin.count x transport.kinesin_cargo_fraction and are dealt in teams of this size to carriers 0, 1, ...: the CARRIER count derives (ceil(motors / team)). Hendricks, Perlson, Ross, Schroeder, Tokito & Holzbaur 2010 Curr Biol 20:697, DOI 10.1016/j.cub.2010.02.058 (PubMed 20399099; ABSTRACT opened 2026-10-13, full text not opened), purified MOUSE NEURONAL transport vesicles, not MCF7: 'Quantitative analysis indicates that vesicles copurify with a low number of stably bound motors: one to five dynein and one to four kinesin motors.' Cell type and cargo class transfer is an assumption (neuronal late endosome / lysosome -> MCF7): SWEPT. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED 10.1016/j.cub.2010.02.058

spec.example.toml · range

cell211–4sweptmeasured
cargo.dynein_per_cargo

dynein motors ONE cargo carrier holds (PI 2026-10-13 18:16 KST, DECISIONS-1013-1816 item 16; bonds.cargo_team / cargo_ranges). The dynein cargo motors stay dynein.count x transport.dynein_cargo_fraction, dealt in teams of this size to carriers 0, 1, ... — the SAME carriers the kinesin teams start on, so a carrier inside both ranges holds both teams and the tug-of-war is the two kinds' own mechanics; carriers past the shorter range hold one species (with the example rows: 800 kinesin / 2 = 400 carriers, 600 dynein / 3 = 200 teams -> 200 carriers with both, 200 kinesin-only). Hendricks, Perlson, Ross, Schroeder, Tokito & Holzbaur 2010 Curr Biol 20:697, DOI 10.1016/j.cub.2010.02.058 (PubMed 20399099; ABSTRACT opened 2026-10-13, full text not opened), purified MOUSE NEURONAL transport vesicles, not MCF7: 'Quantitative analysis indicates that vesicles copurify with a low number of stably bound motors: one to five dynein and one to four kinesin motors.' SWEPT. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED 10.1016/j.cub.2010.02.058

spec.example.toml · range

cell311–5sweptmeasured
cargo.single_motor

switch, DECLARED ARM (PI 2026-10-13 18:16 KST, DECISIONS-1013-1816 item 16; lane l9-motors-cargo-1013): 0 = a carrier holds a TEAM (cargo.kinesin_per_cargo, cargo.dynein_per_cargo) — the default. 1 = the pre-1013 build kept as a comparison arm: one motor per carrier on disjoint carriers (kinesin.count x fraction + dynein.count x fraction carriers; no carrier holds two motors, so no tug-of-war and no team), the per-cargo rows not read

cargo.density

COPIED NUMBER made visible (cell-expand 2026-10-07): bound to fluid.density, which carried the same typed value — its source: 'bulk density is taken as water's'. Unbind when cargo.density gets its own source. Was: EXAMPLE a membranous carrier is mostly enclosed aqueous lumen, so its bulk density is taken as water's; NOT a source row - the source branch instead derived the mass from a lipid-count ledger (cargo.lipid_area, cargo.lipid_molecular_weight) over a meshed vesicle surface, which this lane does not build. PI-GAP

microvillar bundler binding rate — PI-GAP (a target Aleph must find; the number is an initial point). The microvillar bundler is espin / fimbrin (I-plastin) / villin, NOT fascin: microvillus.spacing is 12 nm and that row's own source names those three, while fascin's sourced bundle spacing is 8 nm (filopodium.spacing, Courson & Rock 2010). NO rate constant for espin, fimbrin, I-plastin or villin exists anywhere in this corpus — searched 2026-09-21 over aleph/references, aleph/docs, aleph/laws and this file; every hit says UNSOURCED (KB-DRAFT-3-23, SE_REGISTRATION_CANDIDATES_2026-06-30, architecture_spec.py 'espin/fimbrin STAND-IN'). WARNING, reported not refused: 8.5 nm is 3.5 nm SHORTER than the 12 nm first shell this molecule is asked to bridge — the bond rests at the distance it formed at, so nothing is stretched and no force is injected, but a real espin / fimbrin / villin span would be about 12 nm and this row is where that number belongs when a source gives it. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED | independent of fascin.length: different bundlers; same placeholder value.

build.thermal_attach

switch, not a material value: 1 = a linker with its own rest length (crosslink, filamin) is born by THERMAL attachment at build — each partner in reach weighted exp(-1/2 k (d - r0)^2 / k_BT), the declared count kept and any shortfall reported (bonds._thermal_attach; PI 2026-09-23 21:46 (a)). 0 = the nearest-to-length rule over the 8 nearest nodes (built 614,950 filamins a median 72 nm off rest). linker-build-1013: at crosslink.molecular_model = 1 the same law now draws each ARM of the two-arm molecules (build/crosslinkers.thermal_arms; candidates = live actin nodes in arm_reach, k = 2K, r0 = L/2, cell.temperature), ledger in parts_meta[<molecule>].arm_build; 0 = the uniform draw over monomer sites in reach (the comparison arm; until this lane the row governed no kind of the default build).

build.mt_probe_count

number of golden-shell probe directions that sample the (wrinkled) envelope/membrane radius when an MT build finds the farthest direction (mtoc_position) or the extreme radii of the free-rod box and the inscribed sphere. Numerical resolution, not a material value: it only sets how finely the radius extremum is found (the extremum is a max/min over the probes). Was the literal 4096 in build/microtubule.py. Unsourced: SWEPT over a factor-4 band. PI-GAP (a target Aleph must find). F2 hygiene 2026-10-13 (NO-HIDDEN).

build.strand_shape_rule

switch, not a material value (lane G4 2026-10-13; PI 2026-10-13 18:16 item 1: the bending rest shape of every filament family is straight; 22:32 item 10: for cortex, cytoplasmic actin and intermediate filaments the flip waits until the builders stop producing kinks). 1 = the strand builders lay shapes a STRAIGHT-rest filament can hold: (a) a great-circle arc of the cortex / the cytosolic band is re-laid as a WHOLE strand, still an arc about the cell centre at its built chord, hung its drawn depth under the lowest membrane point (over the highest envelope crest) on its own path (build/part.lay_arcs_under_membrane) — the only curvature left is the sphere's, kappa L / (2 r^2); (b) a persistent walk (keratin network; cytoplasm_actin.network_rule = 1) is a rejection sample of the worm-like chain of the family's own kappa / k_BT confined between the built surfaces' radii — no reflection, no clamp, no wrinkle map (build/part.band_walks inside=); (c) a hung Arp2/3 daughter that would leave the membrane turns about its mother's chord as a straight rod, keeping its branch angle (build/cortex._cap_hung). 0 = the incumbent, bit for bit: every node moved with the local wrinkle (build/part.under_membrane), a specularly reflected walk, a per-node cap — host 2026-10-13: kink median 13.9 deg / 553 kT per formin filament under a straight rest (P04), 12.2 deg / 650 kT (P06), IF 23 deg / 115 kT (P09), which material.<family>.bend_rest = 0 freezes as the zero-energy shape. Node counts, chords, contour, population counts and masses are the same on both arms. 0 until the device record of the T0_smooth_straight arms (VERIFY-EACH); flips together with material.actin.bend_rest / material.if.bend_rest = 1. A file without the row builds arm 0.

cell11examplepi convention
build.walk_restarts

build.strand_shape_rule = 1 only: how many times one walked chain is redrawn from its start before it is laid by the reflected walk instead and counted (part.meta strand_shape.reflected_chains). Numerical budget of a rejection sampler (build/part._confined_walks), not a material value: the kept chains are exact samples of the confined chain whatever the budget, the budget only bounds the build time of a band much thinner than the chain's persistence length (the R 2 um unit world's 0.27 um band). Unsourced: SWEPT over a factor-4 band (as build.mt_place_tries). PI-GAP.

spec.example.toml · range

cell409611024–16384swept
build.walk_step_draws

build.strand_shape_rule = 1 only: draws of ONE step of a walked chain before the chain is abandoned and redrawn from its start (build/part._confined_walks). 1 = the exact rejection sampler of the hard-wall confined worm-like chain (the canonical value: the native band, about 2 um against a keratin persistence length of 0.69 um, accepts 0.2-0.6 of the free chains). > 1 = chain growth without its Rosenbluth weights: every increment is still a thermal draw of the family's own rigidity conditioned on staying between the surfaces, but wall-hugging paths are over-represented — a declared bias, needed where the band is much thinner than the chain (the R 2 um unit world P09: a 0.27 um band, wrinkles of both surfaces inside it; host 2026-10-13: at 1, 8 of 24 chains were still unplaced after 4,096 restarts and fell back to the reflected walk; at 16, none, and the built shape reads l_p 0.77 um against the row's 0.69). Numerical budget, not a material value. Unsourced: SWEPT. PI-GAP.

spec.example.toml · range

cell111–64swept
build.turn_steps

build.strand_shape_rule = 1 only: how many equal azimuth steps over 0..90 deg a straight hung Arp2/3 daughter is tried at when it would leave the membrane as laid in the tangent plane (build/cortex._turn_hung: the whole junction turned about the mother's chord, inward; the smallest step that clears is taken; branch angle, gap and chords unchanged). Numerical resolution of a search, not a material value: 16 = 5.6 deg per step (the tip of a 0.12 um daughter at 70 deg moves 11 nm per step, of the order of the contact distance). Host P05 2026-10-13: 1,325 of 9,421 daughters turned, 90 cleared at no step and were pressed node by node as on arm 0 (counted: part.meta strand_shape.hung_pressed). Unsourced: SWEPT over a factor-4 band. PI-GAP.

build.count_past_nodes

switch, not a material value (silent-loss lane F4 2026-10-13, AUDIT2-C H1; PI 2026-10-07 NO-HIDDEN 'absolutely nothing ignored'): 1 = an areal count row (erm / myo1 / tether_adhesion .areal_density x built area) larger than the owner surface's vertex count is KEPT: vertex v owns floor(n x area share_v) slots and the remainder is drawn once each with probability its fractional part (bonds.kinetic_owners), as a cortex node owns several crosslinkers (B15). 0, or a spec without this row (a record's own spec reproduces its record) = the count is clipped to the vertex count, the build until this lane (host C01: 8,412 of 10,250 declared ERM built, 0.82; U1 the same membrane) — the Core then refuses the world (engine row build.placed_fraction_min) unless the run declares allow_departures. Recorded either way in the run record's build ledger (kinds.<kind>.declared / placed).

spec.example.toml · point

cell11examplepi convention
build.bend_rest_straight

switch, not a material value (E2 (ga) e2bend-1015; PI GO-1015-1713 item E2 (ga) 'straight-rest cover now', default flip is the PI's after device evidence): 1 = every STRAND bending row (a part's own triple block, not a junction row; alive, not a two-direction carrier, not a declared Arp2/3 junction) lays the straight rest s0 = 0 (the kernel's straight form, alpha/2 |x_i - 2x_j + x_k|^2) instead of its as-built magnitude (assemble.straight_all_release). Rows appended after the blocks keep their angle: Arp2/3 roots and nucleation sites, molecular hinges (crosslink.hinge_rule) and growth-born junction rows - a straight rest there would erase the molecule's angle. Why: the curved magnitude form alpha/2 (|d| - s0)^2 has no stiffness against turning d about the strand (an energy zero mode, transverse Hessian coefficient max(1 - s0/|d|, 0) = 0 at the build); the straight form has the full alpha in every direction but prestresses a strand built curved. The run record's build ledger carries bend_rest_straight.<part> = {rows, energy_released_pN_um} (sum alpha/2 |d|^2 at the build). 0, or a spec without this row (a record's own spec rebuilds its record) = every as-built rest kept bit for bit.

cell01examplepi convention
build.bend_rest_snap

switch, not a material value (BENDREST-ROUND-1015; defect: device 0200319cd C05 T310 line search alpha 0, 0/100): 1 = an as-built bending rest s0 = |x_i - 2x_j + x_k| that is positive but within the float64 roundoff of its own coordinates (0 < s0 <= build.bend_rest_snap_ulps x eps64 x (|x_i| + 2|x_j| + |x_k|), engine row) is recorded as exactly 0, the kernel's STRAIGHT form (assemble.roundoff_rest_rows). Why: s0 > 0 selects the curved form whose transverse Hessian coefficient max(1 - s0/|d|, 0) is 0 at the build while the energy has the full alpha a femtometre away, so Newton's model loses the strand's transverse bending stiffness. The energy changes by at most alpha |d| s0 (s0 ~ 1e-16 um): no physical difference, only the model's. 0, or a spec without this row (a record's own spec rebuilds its record) = every as-built rest kept bit for bit. Host builds 2026-10-15 at 7452ab26b: rows snapped (live) C02 T0_fluid 51 (25) and U1 T0_fluid 51 (25), all NMII, ratio s0 / (eps64 x scale) <= 0.36; P08 T0_arm1 (microtubule.bend_rest 0) 1,032 (1,032) MT rows <= 0.26; zero rows on P03, P04, P05, P06, P08 T0, P09, C03, C05 (their strands declare a straight rest or are exact 0) - those build bit-identical tables. Genuinely bent as-built rows (P04 / P09 / P08 arm 1 at bend_rest 0) sit at ratio >= 8.8e10 (s0 >= 1.3e-4 um): none is touched.

spec.example.toml · point

cell11examplepi convention
build.centre_equilibrium

switch, not a material value (start-occupancy lane F6 2026-10-13; PI 2026-10-13 'nothing is placed without the law that governs it'): 1 = the centre of a two-arm crosslinker molecule (crosslink.molecular_model = 1, build.thermal_attach = 1) is drawn from the binding equilibrium of the arm's OWN rows — density rho(x) ∝ (1 + K1 min(1, W(x)))^2 on the cytoplasm, K1 = arm k_on / arm k_off, W = sum over live actin nodes in arm_reach of exp(-1/2 2k (d - L/2)^2 / k_BT) (aleph/cell/build/equilibrium.py: derivation, exact rejection draw, report in part meta centre_build); every declared molecule is placed, the node count is unchanged, the arms are then drawn by bonds._thermal_attach as before. 0 or absent = centres uniform in the cytoplasm, the build until this lane (host P04: 8,060 of 8,647 alpha-actinin molecules with both arms free because 76 % of arms have no actin node in their ~3 nm shell; the law re-applied at those centres gives the same 1,125 bound arms, so the gap to the kinetics' steady state is the centre draw, not the arm draw). Not a biological value: the steady state is the declared kinetics rows' own

spec.example.toml · point

cell11examplepi convention
build.cargo_equilibrium

switch, not a material value (start-occupancy lane F6 2026-10-13): 1 = a cargo carrier's centre is drawn from the binding equilibrium of its motor team's OWN rows — rho(x) ∝ prod over its motor kinds (1 + K1 [a site within reach])^(team), K1 the bound : free odds of the kind's zero-load chain (bonds.stationary), sites = the kind's site lattice on the built microtubules (aleph/cell/build/equilibrium.py; report in the cargo part's meta centre_build); the carrier count is unchanged and bonds.occupy_sites_at_build then draws each motor's state as before. 0 or absent = uniform by volume in the cytoplasm, the build until this lane (host C05: 44 of 800 kinesin and 21 of 600 dynein cargo motors have a microtubule site in reach; 36 / 15 bound). A world without microtubules, or cargo kinds on differing site lattices, keeps the uniform draw (recorded). NOT carried: transport along the microtubule (the start is the attach / detach balance, not the run-length steady state)

spec.example.toml · point

cell11examplepi convention
build.orbit_attach

switch, not a material value (start-occupancy lane F6 2026-10-13): 1 = a site kind with its own rest length whose owners turn on a free hinge (the crossbridge of the two-node head: tip about its fork) starts occupied by ITS runtime attach law — W = sum over free sites within reach of the HINGE of the orbit weight (physics/energy/pairlaw.orbit_weight at the stiff-end limit c = 0), the state from the kind's chain with the attach edge scaled by W, the site ∝ w, and the bound head turned rigidly about its hinge onto the orbit's relaxed length (bonds._orbit_occupy). 0 or absent = the as-built kernel rule the build applied until this lane (the nearest free site within the capture radius of the tip AS PLACED, state from the unscaled zero-load chain: host C02 0 of 204 live heads bound, U1 6; the orbit law at the same geometry gives 6.0 expected on C02, W mean 0.26). The device settle redraws the same law with the solve's blocks

build.pool_budget_rule

PI 2026-10-15 20:52 (1): build within declared molecular total after birth reserve; uniformly thin excess candidates and record reductions. 0 preserves pool-blind construction; 1 budgets before construction.

spec.example.toml · range

cell110–1sourcedpi convention
molecule.distinct_arm_partners

switch, not a material value (start-occupancy lane F6 2026-10-13, Lead follow-up on the equilibrium build's finding): 1 = the two arms of one two-arm crosslinker molecule (alpha-actinin: an antiparallel rod with one actin-binding domain at each end; filamin: a V-shaped dimer) may NOT hold the same partner node — two binding domains cannot occupy one site. One law in three places: the build (centre density 1 + 2 K W + K^2 (W^2 - sum w^2), build/equilibrium.distinct_arm_centres; the arms' joint draw, build/crosslinkers.distinct_arms), the settle's occupancy draw (cell/settle.py: the sibling rule stated in partner nodes) and the runtime attach kernel (physics/kinetics._sibling_objects_free, by_node: a free arm skips the node its sibling arm holds). 0 or absent = independent arms, the build until this row: at the equilibrium of the declared rows 96 % of the bound alpha-actinin molecules of P04 (8,320 of 8,644; U1 79 %) held ONE actin node with both arms and bridged nothing. Not carried by this row: two nodes of the SAME filament remain admissible (no hinge / rod law — reported, PI)

barrier splitting theta in [0, 1] of the energy-based transition law (physics.transition_energy; PI-BATCH-2016 A2): where along the reaction coordinate the barrier sits. NOT MEASURED for this molecule (myo1: row added by l8-param-decisions-1013, PI 2026-10-13 18:16 KST item 6, so the kind has an energy-law form) — SWEPT on its range; 0.5 is the symmetric midpoint, not a fit. theta_bind: the attach weight's share exp(-theta_bind 1/2 k e^2/kT) of the strain energy; the release that mirrors the attach reads 1 - theta_bind (Dembo 1988 harmonic-bond pair: detailed balance at every load). 0 is refused (a weightless attach has no energy to share).

kinetics.transition_law

switch, not a measurement. STAGED (PI 2026-10-08 02:46, ledger CHEM-ENERGY-LAW-STAGED): 0 until the device unit worlds U-C3 (stall) and U-C4 (Boltzmann occupancy) pass, then 1 (aleph/docs/PENDING_DEFAULT_FLIPS.toml energy-transition-law; PREREG-2026-10-08-chem-engine-UC3-UC4). PI-BATCH-2016 A2 (2026-10-07 20:16 KST): 1 = the ENERGY-BASED transition law (physics.transition_energy: rate = k0 exp(-theta dE/kT), dE from the terms' energies before/after the transition at the current configuration; detailed balance by construction) on the crossbridge, kinesin, dynein, crosslinkers and ERM (cell/bonds.LAW_PREFIX); 0 = the declared LEGACY arm (Bell / Pereverzev / f_stall e-fold scales at runtime), kept for comparison (PARALLEL-TRACKS). The measured Bell/Pereverzev/f_stall rows stay as validation ORACLES on both arms.

switch (chem-engine lane, 2026-10-08, Lead order): on the energy arm, the CATCH coordinate — a gated edge's barrier is a declared conformational sub-stroke (kinetics.gate_table; cell/bonds.catch_gates): the crossbridge ADP release (Kovacs 2007) and filamin's catch branch slow under resisting tension through the energy of that sub-stroke. 0 = no gate (every release downhill under tension). species_cloud.enabled

switch, not a material value: 1 makes every growth species with a diffusion row a density cloud / particle field on a box at resolution.spacing (physics.species_cloud; the growth ends read and take their tip cell through physics.local_supply instead of the pool scalar). Shipped 0: a declared arm, written not verified (no device run). The box is the fluid-free arm; the conforming dual cells are stage 3 (Lead Q5)

spec.example.toml · range

cell0.010.0–1.0example
species_cloud.local_depolymerization

switch, not a material value: 1 makes every field-backed end's shortening hazard equal its declared well-mixed off-rate times c_local/c_pool at the end node (physics.end_growth); c_pool is the existing growth pool concentration, so no rate is fitted here. 0 keeps the incumbent off-rate exactly. Requires species_cloud.enabled = 1; default OFF pending the declared device case.

spec.example.toml · range

cell010–1example
species_cloud.local_cutting

switch, not a material value: 1 weights each declared cut-law row's contour hazard and selected cut position by c_local/c_pool at that row's owner node (physics.chain_split); c_pool is the existing growth pool concentration. 0 keeps the incumbent uniform-contour cut law exactly. Requires species_cloud.enabled = 1 and a chain-cut table; default OFF pending the declared device case.

spec.example.toml · range

cell010–1example
species_cloud.domain_depth

the field's domain: cells whose centre lies inside exactly this many closed surfaces (1 = inside the outer sheet and no inner one, the cytoplasm the growth pool's count is over; 2 = a nucleoplasm). Geometry by depth, never a surface's name

spec.example.toml · range

cell1.011.0–2.0example
species_cloud.roi_shell_depth

the particle region, an experiment's declaration (design §7): domain cells within this distance of the domain's edge are particle cells (individual Brownian labels, Lead Q1 P0); 0 = cloud only. A sub-membrane shell is where single-molecule observables and tip supply near the leading edge are read

spec.example.toml · range

cell0.0um0.0–0.5example
species_cloud.field_transitions

switch, not a material value (L5a(ii), GO-1015-1713; new features default OFF, ON is the PI's after device evidence): 1 makes every transition a kind declares in BondKind.field_edges (a cut, release or depolymerising step, by data -- no kind or species is named) fire at r0 * c_local / c_ref, c_local the field concentration of BondKind.field_species at the owner node's cell (physics.field_rates), r0 the table rate AT the reference c_ref = kinetics.<kind>.field_c_ref [uM, a row the declaring kind must add: tag, unit, range, source]. delta -1 takes one unit from the field when the transition applies (a refusal is a null event), +1 gives one back. Needs species_cloud.enabled = 1 (refused otherwise). 0, or a spec without this row = every rate reads the pool scalar bit for bit; a kind that declares an edge while this is 0 is refused. No shipped kind declares one yet

spec.example.toml · range

cell0.010.0–1.0examplepi convention
species_cloud.doi_reactions

switch, not a material value (L5a(iii), GO-1015-1713; new features default OFF, ON is the PI's after device evidence): 1 builds, for every pair in species_build.DOI_PAIRS, three particle species A, B, C on the species field's box and runs the Doi reaction A + B -> C each physical step (physics.doi_reaction: pair closer than reaction.<pair>.radius reacts at reaction.<pair>.lambda). Needs species_cloud.enabled = 1 and species_cloud.roi_shell_depth > 0 (a particle region); refused otherwise. 0, or a spec without this row = no pair is built and the field is what it was

cell010–1examplepi convention
organelle.strand_avoidance

organelle-worlds-1008 (2026-10-08): DECLARED ARM for the strand builders vs the bodies. 0 = none (incumbent: strands are laid before the bodies and do not route around them; the nodes inside are counted in meta foreign_nodes_inside); 1 = reroute (organelles.route_around_bodies: after each population is placed, every strand with a node inside an inflated body is deflected sideways around it, re-walked at its built chord and capped again, lone nodes capped along their ray; moved segments take their final chord as rest; relations to other parts are NOT re-derived — the per-part report is meta strand_avoidance, the residual meta foreign_nodes_inside_after)

inclusion.enabled

SWITCH, not a measurement: 1 binds cell/inclusion_build -> physics/energy/inclusions (surface inclusions on the plasma membrane: area/curvature/voltage-coupled multi-state kinetics feeding the solute flux rows). Needs solute.ion_transport = 1 for any permeation; 0 = the shipped build.

inclusions.example.toml · range

cell010–1example
inclusion.initial_potential

the membrane potential at which the build draws each inclusion's start state from its Boltzmann distribution (the transport's own potential then takes over at the first step). Resting-potential textbook order (Hille); MCF7 PI-GAP: no source consulted for this value; the range is an order-of-magnitude bracket, not a measured range. | param-ledger-1013 s1: the GHK potential of membrane.permeability_k/na/cl and the ion.* rows at 310 K is -61.29 mV (K, Na, Cl only); typed -60 mV matches it to 1.29 mV by coincidence, is NOT derived (would change the value), and does not follow an ion or permeability sweep.

inclusions.example.toml · range

cell-60.0mV-90.0–-30.0swept
inclusion.event_budget

NUMERICAL, not biology: per-inclusion transitions allowed per step; reaching it is recorded (status 2), never clipped silently.

inclusions.example.toml · range

cell64116–1024example
inclusion.nav.density

Nav areal density on the MCF7 plasma membrane; MCF7 is weakly excitable (Nav1.5 is reported in MDA-MB-231, Fraser et al. 2005 Clin Cancer Res — not verified in the KB). PI-GAP: no source consulted for this value; the range is an order-of-magnitude bracket, not a measured range.

inclusions.example.toml · range

cell0.11/um^20.0–5.0swept
inclusion.nav.conductance

unitary Nav conductance, textbook order 15-20 pS (Hille 3e, Na channels chapter). not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

inclusions.example.toml · range

cell17.0pS10.0–25.0swept
inclusion.nav.conductance_ref_conc

the symmetric permeant concentration at which the unitary conductance row is quoted; converts it to the GHK permeability-area pa = gamma kT/(z^2 e^2 c) (cell/inclusion_build.permeability_area). Recording-solution order. PI-GAP: no source consulted for this value; the range is an order-of-magnitude bracket, not a measured range.

inclusions.example.toml · range

cell150.0mM50.0–300.0example
inclusion.nav.theta

DECLARED load split of every transition of this kind (k_f = k0 exp(-theta dE/kT)); only the forward/back RATIO is a law (detailed balance), so theta is a modelling axis, swept.

inclusions.example.toml · range

cell0.510.1–0.9swept

EFFECTIVE gating charge of the reduced C-O step. The TOTAL gating charge per channel is ~12 e (Hirschberg et al. 1995 J Gen Physiol, skeletal Nav — not verified in the KB); a two-state reduction's Boltzmann slope carries less. Swept.

What the tags, source classes and ledgers mean
swept
Uncertain value kept as an axis with a range; the sweep need not have run.
example
A starting value. No literature support is claimed.
sourced
A literature source is attached. Transfer to this cell is not implied.
numerical
Engine layer only: a method choice (budget, tolerance, cadence). Never a physical claim.

Source class says what kind of support a row names: measured 45 (measured in an experiment); model computed 16 (computed by a published model); pi convention 92 (a convention set by the PI); secondary 229 (quoted through a secondary source).

Hidden-constant ledgers list every number still written in code instead of a row.
